summary: IteraCompute gives 30M free tokens per month through its Auto model ID, which routes among currently listed open models such as Qwen3.8-27B and DeepSeek V4.1 as idle capacity becomes available. No credit card or recharge is required. The monthly allowance counts input and output, including reasoning, across all API keys on the account. Context is 128K total, and there is no RPM, TPM or daily token cap. There is no automatic paid overage: an exhausted quota returns 429 until reset. There is no SLA on free capacity, and free accounts may queue during busy periods. The free promotion ends at 00:00 Pacific Time on November 24, 2026.
claim_steps: Register and verify your email, or sign in with Google
Open API Keys, create a key that allows the Auto model ID and save the secret shown once
Replace your-api-key with your key in the sample call (using the Auto model ID) and run it
Success means a non-empty choices[0].message.content; registration or HTTP 200 alone does not complete activation
